language.title: Interface language
language.description: Language of Meetily's menus and screens.

key.label: OpenRouter key
key.hint: One key for everything: summaries, transcription, speaker identification and screen reading.

stt.intro: Live transcription goes through OpenRouter: audio is sent in chunks of about 10 seconds and is not kept by the provider. Expect $0.01 to $0.26 per hour depending on the model.
stt.fallbackHint: If the internet or OpenRouter stops responding, Parakeet takes over on this computer.
stt.concurrencyHint: More simultaneous requests reduce the delay when people talk a lot.
stt.languageElsewhere: Cloud transcription (OpenRouter) has its own language setting: Settings → Transcription → OpenRouter.

cloud.keyDescription: Meetily's cloud steps (transcription, speakers, screen, summary) use this account.
cloud.speakersDescription: When the meeting ends, the full audio is transcribed again with one voice per speaker, then AI assigns the participants' names.
cloud.speakersAutoHint: About $0.22 per hour of audio. The live transcript can be restored.
cloud.diarizationModelHint: Only elevenlabs/scribe-v2 can tell voices apart through OpenRouter.
cloud.namingModelHint: Text model that matches each voice with a participant.
cloud.screenDescription: While recording, a screenshot is kept each time the screen changes (new slide, new document). A vision model then reads them for the summary.
cloud.screenDefaultHint: Value offered when each meeting starts.
cloud.screenIntervalHint: A screenshot is only kept when the screen really changed.
cloud.visionModelHint: Reads the captured slides and documents.
cloud.privacyDescription: Providers that keep or reuse data are always excluded from requests.
cloud.zdrHint: Only use providers that keep nothing. Some models may then become unavailable.

templates.title: Summary templates
templates.name: Template name
templates.instruction: Instruction for AI: what the section must contain
templates.itemFormat: Item format (optional), e.g. a Markdown table header: | **Owner** | Action | Due |

participants.name: Name
participants.hint: People you already met are suggested automatically. The person icon marks who is recording.

context.visioHint: Teams, Zoom, Meet…: your microphone and the computer's sound are kept apart.
context.inPersonHint: Everyone in the same room, one microphone.
context.backgroundPlaceholder: Purpose of the meeting, stakes, history with the client, what matters…
context.glossary: Names and terms to spell correctly
context.instructionsPlaceholder: E.g. focus on the client's commitments, stay factual, keep it short…
context.captureScreenHint: Keeps an image each time the screen changes so AI can read slides and documents. Meetily does not appear in the captures.

setup.title: New meeting
setup.description: This information helps AI understand the conversation and name the speakers. Everything can be edited later.
setup.meetingTitlePlaceholder: Optional, AI will suggest a title
setup.liveDescription: Participants and glossary also help recognize names during transcription.

contextPanel.title: Context and participants
contextPanel.hint: Saved automatically. Used the next time the summary is generated.

speakers.renameHint: Name shown for “{{label}}” throughout the meeting

pipeline.diarizeFailed: Speaker identification failed: the live transcript is kept
pipeline.identifyHint: Transcribes the full audio again with one voice per speaker and assigns the participants' names
pipeline.restoreLiveHint: Restores the transcript made during the meeting
pipeline.rereadHint: Analyse the screenshots again (after excluding some, for instance)
pipeline.costHint: OpenRouter cost of this meeting (transcription, speakers, screen), summary excluded
pipeline.rerunConfirm: Running the identification again replaces the current transcript and the speaker names you set by hand. Continue?

screens.hint: Click a screenshot to enlarge it. The eye excludes a screenshot from the analysis, useful if it shows something private.

tags.title: Tags
tags.description: Group your meetings by client, project or topic, then filter them in the sidebar.
tags.none: No tags yet. Create one below.
tags.deleteConfirm: Delete the tag "{{name}}"? It will be removed from every meeting.

export.hint: Export the audio, transcript or summary
export.title: Export meeting
export.description: A single item is saved as is; several items are bundled into a zip file.

partsHint.transcript: transcription.md, with speaker names and timestamps

notion.title: Notion
notion.description: Automatic backup of your meetings to a Notion database: summary, transcript and details (date, tags, participants, duration).
notion.keyHint: Create an internal integration at notion.so/my-integrations and paste its "Internal Integration Secret".
notion.databaseReady: The database is ready: meetings are sent to it.
notion.shareHint: In Notion, open the page that will hold the database, "…" menu → Connections → add "{{integration}}". Then refresh the list and pick that page.
notion.noPage: No page shared with the integration
notion.syncDescription: Every change (summary, title, speakers, tags, context) is sent to Notion a few seconds later.
notion.autoHint: When off, meetings are only sent on demand.
notion.pending: Waiting to be sent to Notion

search.title: AI search
search.description: Describe what you are looking for in plain words: a topic, people, a time period.
search.placeholder: e.g. the meeting where we discussed SIRIS with Olivier and Maxime
